label: Окно
description: Twelve-mission case drill for окно (window) — all six cases, singular and plural.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative singular. The dictionary form окно stands as the grammatical subject after Это. Neuter nouns in -о take a bare nominative, and for inanimate neuters this same form also serves as the accusative.

Strategic focus: Genitive singular. The nominative окно shifts its ending to окна. The genitive is triggered here by the negation нет together with the possessive у; окно is end-stressed in the singular, so the stress falls on the ending.

Strategic focus: Dative singular. Окно takes the dative ending окну. The preposition к, signalling movement toward a goal, governs the dative. Neuter -о nouns share dative endings with masculine nouns.

Strategic focus: Accusative singular. The direct object of мою appears as окно, identical to the nominative. For inanimate neuter nouns the accusative always equals the nominative, so no ending change occurs.
Strategic focus: Instrumental singular. The nominative окно becomes окном. The preposition под, marking a location underneath, takes the instrumental; the singular stress remains on the ending.
Strategic focus: Prepositional singular. Окно changes to окне after на. The prepositional, here marking location, is the only case that never appears without a preposition; neuter -о nouns take -е.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. The plural subject is окна. Neuter nouns form the nominative plural in -а, shifting the stress back onto the stem after the end-stressed singular.

Strategic focus: Genitive plural. The form окон has a bare stem with a fleeting vowel inserted between the consonants. Negation нет triggers the genitive; neuter -о nouns usually take a zero ending in the genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Dative plural. Окна becomes окнам. The preposition к governs the dative, and the dative plural ending -ам is shared across all genders.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. The direct object окна matches the nominative plural. Since окно is inanimate, the accusative plural equals the nominative plural with no separate ending.

Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. The plural окна takes the ending окнами. The preposition за, marking what lies beyond, governs the instrumental; -ами is the universal instrumental plural ending.
Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. Окна shifts to окнах after в. The prepositional plural ending -ах appears for all genders and, like the singular, never stands without a preposition.
